units.source_text: 另一人轩端荻，已与藏人少将结婚。

en.t: The other woman, Nokiba no Ogi, had already married the Chamberlain Lieutenant.

units.source_text: 源氏公子闻知此消息，想道：“真是不可思议。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard this news, he thought, "How strange it is.

units.source_text: 少将倘看破情况，不知作何感想。”

en.t: If the lieutenant were to see through what happened, I wonder how he would feel."

units.source_text: 他推察少将之心，觉得对他不起，

en.t: He imagined the lieutenant's feelings and felt that he had wronged him,

units.source_text: 又颇想知道轩端荻的近况，便差小君送一封信去。

en.t: and, also wanting very much to know how Nokiba no Ogi was doing, he sent Kokimi to deliver a letter to her.

units.source_text: 信中说：“思君忆君，几乎欲死。

en.t: In the letter he wrote, "Thinking of you and longing for you, I am almost dying.
Do you know this heart of mine?"
